This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Metal and Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 3.6 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

5059442204526.variantName: Blue Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 2ft (60cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 2ft
5059442204526.sourceDescription:
Bring a living tree into your home for Christmas and enjoy the character that comes with choosing a pot-grown Blue Spruce. Its dense blue-green foliage and naturally conical shape create a full, well-balanced tree, while the slightly more rigid needles help the branches hold their shape beneath heavy lights and decorations. The unusual colouring sets it apart from other varieties, giving this real Christmas tree a distinctive appearance without needing to overdo the decorations.
DISTINCTIVE BLUE SPRUCE: Blue-green foliage and dense branching give this tree its characteristic appearance, with a naturally conical shape that looks full and well balanced. It also makes an attractive outdoor Christmas tree once the festive season has finished.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
NEEDLES THAT HOLD WELL: Blue Spruce is known for its good needle retention, helping it maintain a full, fresh appearance throughout the Christmas period. This makes it a practical option for enjoying a real tree indoors without the rapid needle drop associated with some varieties.
YEAR-ROUND EVERGREEN TREES FOR GARDEN STRUCTURE: Blue Spruce keeps its blue-green foliage throughout the year, so its interest doesn't end when the Christmas decorations come down. Its evergreen character can add structure and colour to an outdoor space through every season.
CARE FOR YOUR LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Keep the compost moist while the tree is indoors, but avoid leaving it sitting in excess water. Position it away from radiators, fires, and other direct sources of heat, and keep its time indoors to the festive period rather than treating it like a permanent houseplant.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

This 15-piece set of velvet Christmas baubles comes in four graduated shades: hot pink, blush pink, baby pink and beige. The 15 baubles can be grouped by shade for a graduated effect or mixed together for a fuller, layered look.

Each bauble is handmade, with velvet fabric wrapped around a round plastic ball and finished with a silk ribbon plus pleats in the top fleece for a distinctive, tailored shape. Because the baubles are shatterproof rather than glass, they stay sturdy through the season and can be packed away and reused year after year.

At 80 mm (3.15 in) across, they are large enough to act as focal points and centrepieces on the tree without weighing down the branches. Absorbency is the heart of a good tea towel, and these are made to take up water quickly. They cope with drying, wiping down worktops, mopping up spills and any other household job, and they hold on to that absorbency even after repeated machine cycles. The generous size gives you plenty of cloth to work with, whether you are drying a full dish rack or covering a bowl of dough while it proves.

Each towel measures 18 x 26 inches (43 cm x 66 cm) and the set contains four tea towels in a black and white colourway. The snowman pattern is printed in a stylish, playful design that sits happily alongside Christmas decorations, yet it is calm enough to stay out all winter. Hang them on the oven rail, use them as a soft layer under festive table settings, or give the set as a small Christmas gift for someone who loves seasonal homeware.

5056928934526.variantName: MySmartBuy 60cm LED Bauble Tree, 220 Lights and 66 Red Baubles, Plug In
5056928934526.sourceDescription:
Light up a corner of your home this Christmas with this 60cm LED bauble tree from MySmartBuy. Slender dark twig-style branches spread out from a single trunk, finished with 220 sparkling LED lights in radiating clusters at the tips, and dotted with 66 glittering red mini baubles that catch the light beautifully. The result is a stylish, modern take on the Christmas tree that brings warmth and colour without taking up much space. It stands securely on a sturdy round metal base, so it is perfect for side tables, sideboards, hallway consoles, windowsills and desks, or as a festive feature in a flat, office or bedroom where a full-size tree would not fit. It comes with a plug-in adapter, so it is ready to use straight from the box, with no batteries to buy or replace. The red baubles are already in place, making it a quick and easy way to decorate, and its classic red and warm glow pairs beautifully with gold accents, red table linen and festive greenery. A charming alternative to a traditional tree, and a lovely gift for anyone short on space at Christmas. At a glance: 60cm twig-style tree | 220 LED lights in radiating clusters | 66 red mini baubles | sturdy metal stand | plug-in adapter included | 60 x 13cm diameter.
220 SPARKLING LEDS – Radiating clusters of LED lights to light up a corner.
66 RED BAUBLES – Festive red baubles set among the lights.
STURDY METAL STAND – Stands securely on its base.
PLUG-IN ADAPTER INCLUDED – Ready to use straight from the box.
SIZE – Measures 60 x 13cm diameter.

Because it is fully programmable, you can switch from festive reds and greens at Christmas to oranges and purples for Halloween, making it a decoration you can use for celebrations throughout the year. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The pink finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Pink. Stated size: 55 x 25 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Reusable design allows for storage and repeated use across multiple festive seasons.
Distinctive snowflake detailing adds a winter-themed accent to your Christmas display.
Compact pink plastic construction provides a defined appearance for indoor or outdoor decoration.
Versatile festive door decoration suitable for creating a focal point in seasonal arrangements.

7984702690026.variantName: COSTWAY 3 Pcs Lighted Christmas Reindeer Indoor Outdoor Reindeer Pre-lit Christmas Decoration
7984702690026.sourceDescription:
Don't miss the opportunity to experience the joy that our Christmas lighted reindeer bring to your home!
Why choose us? Compared to other reindeer set that has only 1 deer, our christmas deer family set includes set of 3 deer to convey the concept of warm reunion. With 255 warm white lights, the Christmas reindeer set is an exceptional addition to your holiday decor, offering an enchanting and magical touch to your surroundings. The poses of the 3 reindeer are very vivid as if they are welcoming the Christmas season. In addition, with golden fabric, they will sparkle, especially in the light, giving a unique atmosphere of Christmas. The outdoor holiday ornament is made of snow-resistant fabric and has a waterproof certification that makes it suitable for indoors and outdoors. Supported by metal stand and secured by 4 ground stakes, the reindeer family set get rid of easy to wobble structure. Moreover, it comes with some accessories such as bulbs, fuses for easy replacement and installation. Therefore, the weatherproof & stable deer family set is a great Christmas gift for families or friends.
Captivating & Delicate Appearance: The deer of the lighted Christmas reindeer look up and jump in a very vivid posture, as if welcoming the arrival of Christmas. Their charming gestures will add a unique charm to your yard. In addition, the extra red bows with bells give it a stronger holiday vibe.
Brilliant Lighting Design: The 3 piece reindeer set is equipped with 255 warm white lights, which will add bright visual effects to your neighbors and guests. The shiny appearance will become a striking presence day and night. In addition, using UKCA certified adapters is very secure to use.
Durable Indoor & Outdoor Decor: Constructed from durable fabric and certified with IP44 waterproof rating, our Christmas deer decorations are designed to withstand various weather conditions. Hence, it is suitable for indoors & outdoors, such as living room or backyard, porch, garden, yard, lawn.
Superior Stability for Lasting Joy: Featuring rust-resistant coating, the stable metal base of our outdoor Christmas decorations is lasting and windproof. Additionally, the set includes 4 ground stakes, which further reinforce the stability and prevent the christmas reindeer set from tipping over.
Hassle-free Installation: Detailed instruction and complete components will enable you to easily connect each part for a stunning holiday display. And there exists 8 zip ties to tighten the connection.
Specification: Color: Gold Material: Polyester Fabric + Metal Large Reindeer Size: 135 cm x 27 cm x 152 cm (L x W x H) Medium Reindeer Size: 94 cm x 20 cm x 96 cm (L x W x H) Small Reindeer Size: 50 cm x 18 cm x 75 cm (L x W x H) Net Weight: 6 kg Package includes: 1 x Christmas Lighted Reindeer Set 4 x Ground Stake 8 x Zip Tie 1 x Plug 1 x Instruction
Guarantee - 6 months
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5061127364326.baseName: Nordmann Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Living Premium Evergreen Potted Xmas Tree Reusable Indoor Outdoor Festive Plant
5061127364326.variantName: Nordmann Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Living Premium Evergreen Potted Xmas Tree Reusable Indoor Outdoor Festive Plant · 本规格 / Selected: 4ft
5061127364326.sourceDescription:
LUSH DEEP GREEN FOLIAGE - The Nordmann Fir is a real Christmas tree known for its soft, glossy dark green needles and attractive, traditional shape. Making it a popular choice for creating a classic festive display. Please note that the pot is for illustrative purposes only. You will receive your tree in a black growing pot.
POT GROWN FOR LONG TERM USE - Grown in its pot from the start, this living Christmas tree can be replanted in your garden or kept outdoors in a suitable container after the holidays, offering a sustainable option that can be enjoyed beyond the festive season.
EXCELLENT NEEDLE RETENTION - Nordmann Firs are well known for their excellent needle retention. When properly cared for, this potted tree keeps its lush green appearance throughout the Christmas period, helping your festive display stay looking fresh for longer.
PERFECT FOR FESTIVE DECORATING - With its full shape and evenly spaced branches, the Nordmann Fir provides plenty of room for lights, baubles and other Christmas decorations. Its soft needles also make decorating more comfortable for the whole family.
CLASSIC REAL CHRISTMAS TREE - Bring the natural beauty of a real tree to your festive celebrations. The Nordmann Fir's rich green foliage, soft-touch needles and traditional appearance make it a timeless addition to your Christmas décor.
CARBETH PLANTS - We are a Scottish based company with over 20 years experience in horticulture. With a large variety of plants for the garden, indoors and also gift wrapped for special occasions. We pride ourselves on prompt delivery as well as our quality and affordable plants.
Manufacturer guarantee: 1 month
